homesteadExemptions.notes: Louisiana homestead exemption protects up to $75,000 of equity in the family home from seizure by creditors.

louisianaForcedHeirship.notes: Louisiana forced heirship applies to children under 24 and children of any age who are permanently incapable. The reserved portion is 25% for one forced heir or 50% for two or more.
